signal: PlanSource unveiled a bold brand evolution (Jan 2026) built on AI-driven technology and expanded partner enablement, working with 500+ national and regional brokerage firms.

email.subject1: a signal play for PlanSource partners
email.body1:
Matthew, saw PlanSource unveiled its brand evolution and is leaning into partner enablement across 500-plus brokerage firms.

A reseller channel that size usually surfaces more co-sell accounts than the team can cover before anyone can act on them, and partner-sourced pipeline coverage slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously across the partner ecosystem, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play across PlanSource's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Matthew, quick follow-up for PlanSource.

As partner enablement expands, co-sell opportunities usually outpace the channel team's ability to act on them, and reseller-sourced pipeline stays under-covered. Most teams cannot say how much they are leaving on the table.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how much partner-sourced pipeline PlanSource could cover this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Matthew, last bit of proof for PlanSource.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top reseller targets. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body4:
Matthew, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a brand evolution plus channel push keeps a team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook scoped to PlanSource's reseller channel? I will tailor it either way.
